title: Dependency updates
summary: How quickly third-party libraries are updated, so that known vulnerabilities do not stay in production.
scope: Every repository that builds something deployed to a shared environment. Prototypes that are never deployed are out of scope.

requirements.title: Automated update pull requests
requirements.statement: Every repository has automated dependency updates switched on for all its package ecosystems.
requirements.rationale: Updates that depend on someone remembering do not happen.
guidance: Add the update bot configuration from the repository template.
Group minor and patch updates into one weekly pull request.

verification.description: Repository automation reports repositories without the configuration.

lookFor: A new package manifest (package.json, go.mod, requirements.txt) in a folder the update configuration does not cover

requirements.title: Fix critical vulnerabilities within 7 days
requirements.statement: A dependency with a critical vulnerability is updated or removed within 7 days of the alert in production services.
requirements.rationale: Critical vulnerabilities in common libraries are exploited within days.

requirements.title: Pin exact versions
requirements.statement: Dependencies are pinned to exact versions through a committed lock file.

lookFor: A dependency added with a range (^, ~, >=) or "latest"
A changed manifest without the matching lock file change
